About Kababish

You'll find us at Hasan Plaza in Iqbal Town, Sialkot — a neighbourhood spot for barbecue and fast food, open every single day from noon to midnight.

Our kitchen is built around two things Sialkot loves: a proper desi Chicken Karahi, cooked fresh in the wok, and our specialty paratha rolls — from the creamy Malai Roll to the Chicken Cheese Paratha our regulars ask for by name.

Families, friends, late-evening cravings — walk in, or order ahead on WhatsApp and skip the wait.
